description: qa-browser hooks: SessionStart config/evidence safety check (advisory); PreToolUse production host gate (blocks production hosts, asks for unknown hosts when a QA target is configured); PreToolUse do-not-click skiplist (asks when a click matches the project's skiplist).

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start_target_check.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_navigate_prod_gate.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_click_skiplist.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
